mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = #{billKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND bill_date < #{date}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount + discount_amount), 0) FROM fin_settlement WHERE kind = #{settleKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND settle_date < #{date}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fin_advance WHERE kind = #{settleKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND advance_date < #{date}

SELECT f.biz_date AS "bizDate", f.type AS "type", f.doc_no AS "docNo", f.source_type AS "sourceType", f.source_no AS "sourceNo", f.remark AS "remark", f.linked AS "linkedAp", CASE WHEN f.up = 1 THEN f.amount END AS "increase", CASE WHEN f.up = 1 THEN NULL ELSE f.amount END AS "decrease", CASE WHEN f.discount <> 0 THEN f.discount END AS "discount", SUM(CASE WHEN f.up = 1 THEN f.amount ELSE 0 - f.amount END) OVER (ORDER BY f.biz_date, f.linked, f.seq, f.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "running" FROM () f ORDER BY f.biz_date, f.linked, f.seq, f.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.up = 1 THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "increase", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.up = 1 THEN 0 ELSE f.amount END), 0) AS "decrease", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.linked = 0 AND f.type = 'BILL' THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "bill", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.linked = 0 AND f.type IN ('SETTLEMENT', 'ADVANCE') THEN f.amount - f.discount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "receipt", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.linked = 0 THEN f.discount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "discount", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.linked = 0 AND f.type = 'NETTING' THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "netting" FROM () f

SELECT r.* FROM () r ORDER BY
r.partner_code r.opening r.bill_balance r.advance_balance r.bad_debt r.discount r.linked_ap r.net DESC,
r.net DESC, r.partner_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.opening), 0) AS opening, COALESCE(SUM(r.bill_balance), 0) AS bill_balance, COALESCE(SUM(r.advance_balance), 0) AS advance_balance, COALESCE(SUM(r.bad_debt), 0) AS bad_debt, COALESCE(SUM(r.discount), 0) AS discount, COALESCE(SUM(r.linked_ap), 0) AS linked_ap, COALESCE(SUM(r.net), 0) AS net FROM () r
